Y O U R B O O K I N G , S T E P B Y S T E P Booking Procedure

Open booking website

Choose your date & hostel

Open the Sabah Parks reservation portal. Read the booking disclaimer, check available dates and choose a hostel that matches your eligibility. Enter each climber’s details exactly as shown on their identity document.

01



Online payment

Pay for the package

Accommodation, meals, permit, insurance and service charge are paid with your booking. Pay immediately within the checkout time limit.

At the park · cashless

Conservation & certificate

Pay conservation fees and any required parking charge cashlessly on arrival. Optional climbing certificates are also paid cashlessly.

At the park · cash

Guide, transport & porter

Bring enough cash for your mountain guide, the return transfer to Timpohon Gate and a porter if you choose one.

Pay online immediately

Complete the booking payment online within the payment time shown. An unpaid reservation will be cancelled without notice when that time expires. Check all names and dates carefully: name replacements are not allowed and cancellations are non- refundable.

02

Save your confirmation

Keep your booking invoice and QR code. Online self-check-in becomes available five days before the climb. Complete it for your booking and prepare the completed indemnity form for every climber.

03

Y O U R T W O - D A Y J O U R N E Y

Climbing Itinerary

The same itinerary applies to Lemaing and Panalaban Hostel packages. Follow your guide’s instructions; weather, trail conditions and safety may change the plan.

DAY 1

Registration & Ascent

Kinabalu Park → Timpohon Gate → Panalaban 7:00 am–10:30 am

Arrive & register

Pay the conservation fee at the main gate using cashless payment. Pay parking, if required, cashlessly too.



DAY 2

Summit Ascent & Descent

Panalaban → Low’s Peak → Timpohon Gate

Go to the Climbing Registration Counter at the Visitor Centre. Show your invoice and QR code, present your identity document and submit the required copies and indemnity forms.

Arrange and pay cash for your mountain guide, transport and optional porter. Collect your permit tag and meet your assigned guide.

After registration

Start from Timpohon Gate

Transfer to Timpohon Gate with your guide, attend the rules-and-regulations briefing and begin the ascent to Panalaban.

From 1:00 pm

Check in at your hostel

Check in at the Lemaing or Panalaban Hostel you booked, then rest and prepare for the early summit ascent.

4:30 pm–7:00 pm

Dinner

Dinner is served at Laban Rata Resthouse (SSL).

2:00 am–3:30 am

Pre-climb supper & ascent

Have supper at Laban Rata Resthouse (SSL), then begin the ascent to Low’s Peak with your guide.

By 5:30 am

Reach Sayat-Sayat checkpoint

Show your permit tag. Continue only as directed by your guide and park officials.

Around sunrise

Low’s Peak & descent to Panalaban

Aim for sunrise at the summit, allow about 10–15 minutes for photographs, then descend with your guide. Weather and safety conditions determine whether the summit can be reached.

7:30 am–10:30 am

Breakfast & hostel check-out

Breakfast is at Laban Rata Resthouse (SSL). Check out by 10:30 am; late check-out is charged at RM 100 per hour.

Before 4:00 pm

Return to Timpohon Gate

Aim to reach Timpohon Gate before 4:00 pm. After 4:00 pm, the extra charge is RM 15 per hour per climber. Transfer back to the Visitor Centre.

B E F O R E Y O U C O N F I R M

Changes & cancellations

No name replacements. Check every climber’s name before paying.

One date change only. The new date must be within the same year and is subject to available slots and accommodation.

Give at least two weeks’ notice. Notify the reservation team before your original climb date. The two-week period includes weekends and public holidays.

Cancellations are non-refundable. There is also no refund for weather-related climb cancellations once you have passed Timpohon Gate.

Date-change penalty per climber

Climber 18+ ≤ 17

Malaysian RM110 RM60

International RM410 RM210

These are date-change penalties, not hostel package prices. The international category applies to eligible Panalaban bookings.

A S A F E C L I M B S T A R T S W I T H P R E P A R A T I O N Climbing Safety

On the trail

Check your guide’s ID card, stay with your group and assigned guide, and follow their instructions throughout the climb.

Tell your guide immediately if you feel unwell or face any difficulty.

Wear and display your permit tag. Show it at Timpohon Gate, Laban Rata and Sayat-Sayat during ascent and descent, and whenever officials request it.

Use the white rope at all times on the section above Panalaban towards the summit, both ascending and descending. Keep to it if visibility becomes poor or you become separated from the group.

Expect limited mobile-phone and internet coverage. Save your documents offline before travelling.

IF YOU LOSE YOUR GUIDE AND THE ROPE

Stop. Stay put. Blow your whistle.

Stop immediately and signal for help. Do not attempt to find your own way out or continue climbing alone.

CHECK YOUR HEALTH BEFORE BOOKING

Health restrictions for this climb

Please refrain from climbing if you suffer from, or have a history of, any of the following conditions. Speak with a qualified clinician about your health and high-altitude travel before planning a climb.

Heart disease

Hypertension

Chronic asthma

Peptic ulcer

Severe anaemia

Diabetes

Epileptic fits

Arthritis

Palpitations

Hepatitis / jaundice

Muscular cramps

Obesity / being overweight

Any other illness that may be triggered by severe cold, exertion or high altitude 
